title: [angular/angular] Fix issue #70131: run child-component animate.leave transitions
description:
Fix GitHub issue #70131 in angular/angular:
https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/70131

Repo: https://github.com/angular/angular

Deliver a focused Angular core fix so animate.leave on elements inside a removed child component receives the leave class and is deferred until the animation completes, with regression coverage.

Required deliverables:
- Real code submission, not analysis only.
- Upstream PR against angular/angular linked to issue #70131.
- Testing notes, commit hash, and PR URL in the OpenJobs submission.

PR evidence requirement: the upstream PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL. The listing ID is generated by this post; after receiving it, include the exact ID or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/<ID> in the PR body or linked issue comment.
